GetHelp.Question: How do I get help in RyoGo?
GetHelp.Answer: The fastest way to get answers is to browse through our detailed support documentation pages. If you still need help, you may contact our support team. If you want fast-tracked resolution, you may raise support tickets. This feature is only available in Premium plan.

Learn.Question: How do I learn more about RyoGo app and its features?
Learn.Answer: You can find all the learning resources you need in our Help & Support center under categorized pages. Moreover, you can find demo tutorial videos here (and on our YouTube channel). You can always contact our support team for any queries.

Started.Question: How do I get started in RyoGo?
Started.Answer: Since you are here, that means you already have an account with us. Now you can visit 'Getting Started' help page to know the next steps.

Account.Question: How do I know more about my account?
Account.Answer: You can visit 'Accounts & Subscription' help page to learn all about how Accounts work in RyoGo.

Bookings.Question: How do I create and manage bookings?
Bookings.Answer: Please visit 'Bookings' help page to learn about how Bookings work in RyoGo. You can create a booking by clicking the 'New Booking' option in the header bar.

Vehicles.Question: How do I manage vehicles in RyoGo?
Vehicles.Answer: RyoGo removes all the headache of managing your vehicles by bringing all the information in a single hub. You may visit 'Vehicles' help page to learn all about fleet management.

Drivers.Question: How do I onboard drivers?
Drivers.Answer: You can visit 'Drivers' help page to know all about driver-related features in RyoGo.

Users.Question: How do I manage users in my agency?
Users.Answer: Everyone who can login to RyoGo as part of your agency (agents and drivers) are your users. Please visit 'Users' help page to understand more about user management in RyoGo.

Customers.Question: How do I add customers in RyoGo?
Customers.Answer: RyoGo helps you maintain all your customers details in one place instead of lookng around and going through multiple notebooks. Learn all about customer management in 'Customers' help page.

Subscription.Question: How does subscription work?
Subscription.Answer: Every agency has a subscription plan associated with it. 'Basic' is our free forever plan with basic features and limited usage. 'Premium' is our paid plan with advanced features and unlimited usage. You can upgrade your plan at any time. We also provide a {days} day free premium trial. WhatIsBooking.Title: What is a booking?
WhatIsBooking.Description: A booking is a trip booked by a customer at your agency from one location to another with a driver and a vehicle to fulfill it.
WhatIsBooking.AllBookings: You can view all bookings in your agency by going to bookings page.

Elements.Title: Booking elements
Elements.Description: A booking consists of various elements to describe its details.
Elements.Caption: A list of booking elements
Elements.BasicInfoDesc: Basic details about the booking like booking ID, status, assigned agent, etc.
Elements.CustomerDesc: Details about customer like name, phone number, address, etc.
Elements.TripDetailsDesc: Details about trip like source, destination, type (one-way, round-trip, multi-day), number of passengers, wants AC, pickup date, time, etc.
Elements.AssignmentDesc: Vehicle and Driver assigned for the booking.
Elements.VariablesDesc: Factors which will decide the price of the booking, such as distance, vehicle rate per km, driver allowance per day, commission rate, etc.
Elements.PriceDesc: Final price calculated based on all the above factors. Once booking is created, this cannot be changed.
Elements.ExpensesDesc: All the extra cost incurred after the trip starts, like fuel, toll, etc.
Elements.TransactionsDesc: All the money transactions related to the booking, like payment from customer, cash given to/from driver, etc.
Elements.TripLogsDesc: Location and timestamp log of each activity in the booking from trip start to end.
Elements.RatingDesc: Average rating given by customer and driver for a completed booking.

StatusList.Title: Booking status
StatusList.Description: A booking will have the different status based on the progress of the trip.
StatusList.Caption: A list of booking status
StatusList.Lead: A booking that is created but not yet confirmed by the assigned agent.
StatusList.Confirmed: A booking that has been confirmed by the assigned agent with pickup time and address. It can now be shared with the customer and the driver.
StatusList.InProgress: A booking that is currently being executed by the driver on the road.
StatusList.Completed: A booking that has been completed by the driver.
StatusList.Cancelled: A booking that has been cancelled by the assigned agent. A booking which once started by the driver cannot be cancelled. (An old lead booking is automatically cancelled by the system if the trip date has passed.)

HowToCreate.Description: You can create a booking by going to the 'New Booking' page and filling in the required details like customer, vehicle, driver, trip details and more.

Step1.Title: Step1: Customer details
Step1.Description: Find and select a customer using phone number. If not found, you can add a new customer

Step2.Title: Step2: Trip details
Step2.Description: Provide the trip details like source, destination, type, number of passengers, dates, etc.

Step3.Title: Step3: Assignment
Step3.Description: Choose a vehicle and driver for the trip (This is optional during creation).

Step4.Title: Step4: Variables
Step4.Description: Enter the variable details like vehicle fare, driver allowance and commission rate to calculate the final price.

Step5.Title: Step5: Finalize & Create
Step5.Description: Review the booking details and create the booking. If you want, you can go back to previous steps and change any details. Once booking is created, details cannot be changed.

Creation.Lead: Upon creation the booking will still be a Lead and will have to be confirmed by the assigned agent with pickup time and address from the customer.
Creation.ShareQuote: A booking quotation for a created lead booking (pdf) can be shared with the customer over Whatsapp. So that the customer can review the details and confirm the trip.
Creation.Default: The system will automatically calculate the final price based on distance and default variables set in your agency details. However, you can change these variables while creating a booking in Step 4.

FinalPrice.Title: Final Price
FinalPrice.Description: The final price is calculated based on the distance between source and destination, trip type, vehicle raet per km, driver allowance per day and commission rate.
FinalPrice.Example: For a simple example, if the trip is one-way with a distance of 100 km, the final price will be 100 x 10 (vehicle rate per km) + 500 (driver allowance for one day) with a 10% (commission rate) = Rs. 1650

Elements.Title: Price Elements
Elements.Description: The price details consist of the following elements:
Elements.Caption: A list of price elements
Elements.VehicleRateDesc: The rate for the vehicle per Km. (Min ₹0, Max ₹100)
Elements.DriverAllowanceDesc: The allowance for the driver per day. (Min ₹0, Max ₹10000)
Elements.ACChargeDesc: The extra charge for AC vehicles (if applicable) on per day basis. (Min ₹0, Max ₹10000)
Elements.CommissionDesc: The commission added by the agency. (Min 0%, Max 100%)
Elements.FuelCharges: You can choose to include fuel charges in the vehicle rate itself or add them later as additional expenses.

Confirming.Title: Confirming a booking
Confirming.Description: Once a booking is created, it must be confirmed by the assigned agent (or owner) with pickup time and address, before it can be started.
Confirming.Step1: Step1: Provide the pickup time and address and the drop address.
Confirming.Step2: Step2: Review the booking details and click on 'Confirm Trip'.
Confirming.Share: Once a booking is confirmed, it can now be shared (as a pdf) with the customer over Whatsapp. Also, the assigned driver will receive booking in their app.

Cancelling.Title: Cancelling a booking
Cancelling.Description: A booking can be cancelled by the assigned agent (or owner).
Cancelling.Step: You can cancel a trip by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Cancel Trip'. A booking once cancelled, cannot be undone.
Cancelling.Warning: A booking which has been started by the driver cannot be cancelled. That is, only a LEAD or CONFIRMED booking can be cancelled.
Cancelling.Share: If a confirmed booking is cancelled, a cancellation message can be shared with the customer over Whatsapp.

WhyReconcile.Title: Why reconcile a booking
WhyReconcile.Description: Once a booking is completed, it can be reconciled by the owner. This is an optional step to ensure the authenticity of the trip completion and the final amount.
WhyReconcile.Reason: Reconciling helps make sure all the bills and expenses are added correctly for the booking and the final amount is calculated correctly. It also helps to get a complete picture of your revenue.
WhyReconcile.OnlyPremium: This feature is available only in Premium plan.

Reconciling.Title: Reconciling process
Reconciling.Step: You can reconcile a trip by going to the completed booking details page and clicking on 'Reconcile Trip'.
Reconciling.Process: As part of reconciling, you can add any additional expenses incurred during the trip and mark the trip as reconciled. Once a trip is reconciled, it cannot be undone.

AssignVehicle.Title: Assigning a vehicle
AssignVehicle.Description: You must assign a vehicle to a booking before it can start. You can assign a vehicle by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Assign Vehicle'.
AssignVehicle.Reassign: You may also reassign another vehicle to a booking. This can be done only until the trip starts.

AssignDriver.Title: Assigning a driver
AssignDriver.Description: You must also assign a driver to a booking. You can assign a driver by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Assign Driver'. Once assigned, the driver will be able to see the booking in their app.
AssignDriver.Reassign: You may also reassign another driver to a booking. This can be done only until the trip starts.

ReassignUser.Title: Reassigning a user
ReassignUser.Description: As owner, you can also reassign the booking to another agent or yourself. You can reassign user by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Change Agent'. Once reassigned, the new agent will be able to see the booking in their app.

WhatIsTransaction.Title: What is a transaction?
WhatIsTransaction.Definition: A transaction is any money movement related to the booking that you may want to log. Such as (advance or final) payment from customer, cash handed to driver before trip, or received from driver after trip, etc.
WhatIsTransaction.Description: You can view all transactions related details like amount, date, mode, and more by going to transaction details tab under a booking.

AddingTransaction.Title: Adding a transaction
AddingTransaction.Description: The assigned agent (or owner) can add a transaction by going to the booking transactions page and clicking on 'Add Transaction'.
AddingTransaction.Process: To add a transaction, you must provide the following details: type (credit/debit), amount, payment mode (upi, cash, etc.), other party (customer/driver), photo proof (optional), and remarks (optional)

ModifyingTransaction.Title: Modifying a transaction
ModifyingTransaction.Description: The assigned agent (or owner) can modify a transaction by going to the booking transactions page and clicking on 'Edit' against a transaction'. All the details can be edited.

ApprovingTransaction.Title: Approving a transaction
ApprovingTransaction.Description: The owner can approve a transaction by going to the booking transactions page and clicking on 'Approve' against a transaction'. This helps during the reconciling process.

WhatIsExpense.Title: What is an expense?
WhatIsExpense.Definition: An expense is any additional cost incurred during the trip which was paid by the agency/driver but which shall be borne by the customer in final invoice. Such as, fuel, toll, parking, etc.
WhatIsExpense.Description: You can view all expenses related details like amount, type, and more by going to expense details tab under a booking.

AddingExpense.Title: Adding an expense
AddingExpense.Description: The assigned agent, driver, or owner can add an expense by going to the booking expenses page and clicking on 'Add Expense'.
AddingExpense.Process: To add an expense, you must provide the following details: type (fuel, toll, etc.), amount, photo proof (optional), and remarks (optional)

ModifyingExpense.Title: Modifying an expense
ModifyingExpense.Description: The assigned agent, driver, or owner can modify an expense by going to the booking expenses page and clicking on 'Edit' against an expense'. All the details can be edited.

ApprovingExpense.Title: Approving an expense
ApprovingExpense.Description: The owner can approve an expense by going to the booking expenses page and clicking on 'Approve' against an expense'. This helps during the reconciling process.

ExpenseTypes.Title: Expense types
ExpenseTypes.Description: This is the list of expense types that are allowed for a booking.

WhatIsTripLog.Title: What is a trip log?
WhatIsTripLog.Definition: A trip log is created as and when driver updates the current status of an ongoing trip.
WhatIsTripLog.Description: You can view all trip logs related details like current trip status, start time, end time, distance, and more by going to your trip logs details tab under booking page.

TypeList.Title: Trip Log Types
TypeList.Description: These are the different types of trip logs that will be generated for a booking as it progresses. For trips which take place over multiple days, multiple trip logs of same type may be generated.
TypeList.Caption: A list of trip log types
TypeList.Started: The trip has been started by the driver.
TypeList.Arrived: The driver has arrived at the pickup location of the customer.
TypeList.PickedUp: The customer has been picked up by the driver.
TypeList.Dropped: The customer has been dropped by the driver at the destination location.
TypeList.Ended: The trip has been ended by the driver. The booking is now considered as completed.

Integration.Title: Communication integration
Integration.Description: The platform makes sure that you are always connected with your customers and drivers.
Integration.Whatsapp: Because of deep integration with Whatsapp, you can always send messages (with documents and links) to your customers and drivers for a booking.
Integration.Email: Morever, the platform is email integrated, and therefore emails are automatically sent out at important milestones, wherever applicable.

Customer.Title: Interacting with customers
Customer.Description: You can send messages to the customer by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Chat with customer'.

Driver.Title: Interacting with drivers
Driver.Description: You can also send messages to the driver from booking details page and clicking on 'Chat with Driver'.

Sharing.Title: Sharing documents
Sharing.Description: You can share booking related documents with the customer over Whatsapp with our integrated feature.

BookingQuote.Title: Booking Quotation
BookingQuote.Description: When a new booking is created as a lead, a booking quotation is generated. This quotation can be shared with the customer over Whatsapp.

BookingConfirm.Title: Booking Confirmation
BookingConfirm.Description: When a new booking is confirmed by the assigned agent, a booking confirmation is generated and automatically sent to customer email. This confirmation can alsobe shared with the customer over Whatsapp.

BookingInvoice.Title: Booking Invoice
BookingInvoice.Description: When a new booking is completed, an invoice is generated and automatically sent to customer email. This invoice can also be shared with the customer over Whatsapp.

FAQs.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs.Description: Get answers to common questions related to bookings

Reassign.Question: Can I reassign a booking?
Reassign.Answer: Yes, owner can reassign bookings to another user (or himself).

Lead.Question: What happens to a lead booking if it is not confirmed?
Lead.Answer: If a lead booking is not confirmed within {days} days of the trip start date, it is automatically cancelled.

Price.Question: How is the price calculated for a booking? Can I change it?
Price.Answer: No, you cannot change the price of a booking after it is created. (This is to prevent chances of fraud. You can cancel the current booking and create a new booking with different prices.) The price is calculated based on factors such as distance, vehicle rate per km, driver allowance per day, commission rate, etc. The default values for all these factors can be overridden and changed at the time of booking creation.

Expenses.Question: Do expenses get added to the invoice at the completion of the booking?
Expenses.Answer: Yes, approved expenses are used in final price adjusment when an invoice is being generated for a completed trip.

Transactions.Question: Do transactions get added to the invoice at the completion of the booking?
Transactions.Answer: No, transactions are purely for tracking of money transactions. They are not used for invoice final amount adjustment.

SupportCustomersHelp.Title: Customers
SupportCustomersHelp.Description: Get help related to customer management

KnowCustomer.Title: Knowing your customers
KnowCustomer.Description: A customer is the entity to which each booking is mapped. Therefore, when creating a new booking, customer is the first thing you must select.
KnowCustomer.AllCustomers: You can view (or search through) all your customers by going to the customers page.

CustomerDetails.Title: Customer details
CustomerDetails.Description: You can view all the details of a customer by going to the customer details page.
CustomerDetails.Elements: Customer details include: Name, Phone, Email, Address, Location (city & state), Photo, Remarks, Rating, Status, etc.

StatusList.Title: Customer status
StatusList.Description: A customer will have different statuses
StatusList.Caption: A list of customer status
StatusList.Active: Customer is active and can be selected for making new bookings
StatusList.Inactive: Customer has been inactivated by your agency and cannot make new bookings. Although, any ongoing booking for this customer can proceed.
StatusList.Suspended: Customer has been banned by us. The customer will not be allowed to make any bookings.

AddingCustomer.Title: Adding a new customer
AddingCustomer.Description: You can add a new customer by going to the customers page and clicking on 'Add Customer'.

AddingInBooking.Title: Adding customer in a new booking
AddingInBooking.Description: When creating a new booking, if you cannot search for an existing customer by phone number, you must create a new customer.
AddingInBooking.Required: The required details for creating a customer are: Name, Phone and Location (City, State)

EditingCustomer.Title: Modifying customer details
EditingCustomer.Description: You can edit all the customer details by clicking on 'Edit Details' in the customer details page.

UpcomingBookings.Title: Assigned bookings
UpcomingBookings.Description: You can view all the upcoming bookings (including any ongoing booking) for a customer by going to the Upcoming tab.

CompletedBookings.Title: Completed bookings
CompletedBookings.Description: You can also view all the past bookings made by a customer by going to the Completed tab.

ContactingCustomer.Title: Contacting a customer
ContactingCustomer.Description: You can communicate with your customer during a booking through the platform directly.
ContactingCustomer.Contact: The assigned agent (or owner) can chat or call the customer from the booking details page.

SearchingCustomer.Title: Searching for a customer
SearchingCustomer.Description: You can lookg for a customer in your customer list by typing their name, phone, location, etc.

FAQs.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs.Description: Get answers to common questions related to customers

Tracking.Question: Can I share the booking status with the customer?
Tracking.Answer: Yes, you can share the live tracking link for a booking (from booking details page) with the customer.

Rating.Question: Can a customer rate the booking?
Rating.Answer: Yes, at the end of the trip, the customer can rate the vehicle, the driver and the overall booking experience.

AddingDetails.Question: What details are required to add a customer?
AddingDetails.Answer: To add a customer, the mandatory details are phone number, name and location (city and state). other details like email, etc. can be added later.

SupportDriversHelp.Title: Drivers
SupportDriversHelp.Description: Get help related to driver management

KnowDriver.Title: Know your driver
KnowDriver.Description: Driver is the entity which will execute a booking from start to complete it. Therefore, a driver must be assigned to a booking before it can start.
KnowDriver.AllDrivers: You can view all the drivers in your agency by going to the drivers page.

DriverDetails.Title: Driver details
DriverDetails.Description: A driver has various details associated with it.
DriverDetails.Caption: A list of driver details
DriverDetails.BasicDesc: Name, phone, address, Driver Id, etc.
DriverDetails.LicenseDesc: License number, expiry date, license photo, etc.
DriverDetails.VehiclesDesc: Vehicle types that the driver can drive (like car, bus, bike). Useful in selecting driver for a new booking based on customer's requested vehicle.
DriverDetails.AllowanceDesc: Default driver allowance per day. This will be used to calculate the booking quote for the customer. This can be changed while create a booking.
DriverDetails.RatingDesc: Average driver rating. Provided by customers after each booking.

StatusList.Title: Driver status
StatusList.Description: A driver will have a status to identify their current availability.
StatusList.Caption: A list of driver status
StatusList.Available: The driver is available right now. He is not on a trip.
StatusList.OnTrip: The driver is currently working on a trip.
StatusList.Inactive: The driver has been inactivated by the agency and cannot be assigned to any booking.
StatusList.Suspended: The driver has been banned by us and cannot login to the platform.

AddingDriver.Title: Adding a new driver
AddingDriver.Description: Owner or agent can add a new driver to the agency by going to the drivers page and clicking on 'Add Driver'.

Step1.Title: Step 1: Driver Info
Step1.Description: Provide basic driver info like name, phone, email, and photo.

Step2.Title: Step 2: License Info
Step2.Description: Provide driver license info: license number, expiry date, and license photo/screenshot.

Step3.Title: Step 3: Agency related Info
Step3.Description: Provide agency related info for this driver: address, types of vehicle that he can drive, and default driver allowance per day.

Step4.Title: Step 4: Confirm
Step4.Description: Confirm all the details and submit to add a new driver.

DriverInvite.Title: Driver invite
DriverInvite.Description: As soon as driver is added, an invite is sent to the driver's provided email for them to login and join the agency.

ModifyingDriver.Title: Modifying driver details
ModifyingDriver.Description: You can edit driver information by going to the driver details page and clicking 'Edit Details'.

BookingAssignment.Title: Booking assignment
BookingAssignment.Description: You can assign a booking (lead or confirmed) to a driver. Go to the booking details page and select 'Add driver'.

Selection.Title: Driver selection
Selection.Description: You must select a driver from the list of agency drivers during booking assigninment.
Selection.Score: We also provide a score for each driver to help you in selecting the best driver for a booking. This score is generated based on driver's availability, schedule, license status, rating, type of vehicle he can drive and other such factors.

Reassignment.Title: Reassigning a booking
Reassignment.Description: You can also reassign a booking to another driver. Go to the booking details page and select 'Change driver'.
Reassignment.Warning: A booking which has started cannot be reassigned to another driver.

UpcomingBookings.Title: Assigned bookings
UpcomingBookings.Description: You can view all the upcoming bookings (including any ongoing booking) for a driver by going to the Upcoming tab.

CompletedBookings.Title: Completed bookings
CompletedBookings.Description: You can also view all the past bookings completed by a driver by going to the Completed tab.

WhatIsLeave.Title: Understanding driver leaves
WhatIsLeave.Description: If a driver is taking a leave, you can keep track of that. This also ensures that such drivers are not assigned a booking.
WhatIsLeave.AllLeaves: You can view all leaves (in future and past) taken by a driver by going to Leaves tab on driver details page.

AddingDriverLeave.Title: Adding a driver leave
AddingDriverLeave.Description: You can add a driver leave by going to the driver leaves page and clicking on 'Add Leave'.
AddingDriverLeave.Fields: You must provide the leave start date, end date, whether the leave has already been taken and remarks, if any.

EditingDriverLeave.Title: Editing a driver leave
EditingDriverLeave.Description: You can edit a driver leave details by selecting the leave and clicking on 'Edit'.
EditingDriverLeave.MarkCompleted: Make sure to mark the leave as completed once the driver leave is over. You will receive reminder for this in mission control.

WhatIsDriverApp.Title: Understanding driver app
WhatIsDriverApp.Description: The driver app is another side of RyoGo app that allows drivers to accept and complete bookings. This way, the driver can always keep the live booking status updated for the agency and customers.
WhatIsDriverApp.Use: You can use the driver app the same way you use RyoGo app using your browser.
WhatIsDriverApp.Download: Alternatively, the driver app can also be used by downloading the PWA from your browser. Just click 'Install App' prompt in your browser.

Features.Title: Features in driver app
Features.Description: Through driver app, the driver can perform a lot of activities. Some of these are common with agency users while some are exclusive to driver role.
Features.Caption: A list of features in driver app
Features.BookingsDesc: View all the assigned and completed bookings in the driver app.
Features.ExecutionDesc: Start and execute the currently assigned trip with a customer till completion.
Features.VehicleDesc: View assigned vehicle details and documents
Features.ExpensesDesc: Add and edit expenses incurred in the trip.
Features.CommunicationDesc: Chat with or call the customer or the agency for any queries.
Features.AlertsDesc: Get alerts related to trips, bookings, etc.

FAQs.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs.Description: Get answers to common questions related to drivers

Overlap.Question: How do we ensure that a driver is not assigned to multiple bookings at the same time?
Overlap.Answer: Firstly, during assignment, the system shows the status as 'Booked' with a low score for the driver. Secondly, you can check the driver schedule to ensure that the driver is not assigned to another booking or on leave during that time. In case any such instance is found, the bookings schedule will show a red flag for immediate attention.

Rating.Question: Can a driver rate a booking?
Rating.Answer: Yes, at the end of the trip, the driver can rate the customer and the overall trip experience.

LoginDriverApp.Question: Can we login to the driver app?
LoginDriverApp.Answer: No, only the user with a 'Driver' role can login to the driver app to execute trips. Agents and Owners cannot.

SupportMissionsHelp.Title: Alerts & Notifications
SupportMissionsHelp.Description: Get help related to alerts and notifications

WhatAreMissions.Title: Understanding missions
WhatAreMissions.Description: Missions are basically alerts generated by the system for a user to act upon. These can be critical or non-critical missions.
WhatAreMissions.AllMissions: You can view all your missions on Mission Control page (Target button in the header).

Elements.Title: Elements of a mission
Elements.Description: A mission informs about an event which has happened or about to happen and requires user's attention. The following elements in a mission helps you understand the message:
Elements.Caption: A list of mission elements
Elements.EntityDesc: The entity for which this alert is generated. The entity can be a booking, customer, driver, agency, etc. For example, when an assigned booking has completed, you will receive an alert for this booking.
Elements.MessageDesc: The message is a summary of the alert.
Elements.ActionsDesc: The actions that the user can take in response to this alert.
Elements.DueDateDesc: The date by which this alert should be resolved.
Elements.StatusDesc: The status of the alert. If the alert has already been read/completed by the user, it will be greyed out.

ReadingMission.Title: Marking a mission as read
ReadingMission.Description: Once you have read/completed an alert, you can mark it as completed. This action can be undone by clicking on the completed check mark again.

ActingMission.Title: Acting on a mission
ActingMission.Description: You can take actions on a mission by clicking on the action link. For example, you can click on the link to view booking details and status.

ExpiryAlerts.Title: Get expiry alerts
ExpiryAlerts.Description: You will also receive alerts for expiry. For example, if a driver's license is about to expire, or a vehicle's insurance.
ExpiryAlerts.Items: System will generate alerts for the following items: Driver license, Driver leaves, Vehicle insurance, PUC, RC, repairs.

WhatIsCustomMission.Title: Understanding custom mission
WhatIsCustomMission.Description: Premium plan provides an option to create missions (custom alerts/reminders).
WhatIsCustomMission.Need: You can create custom missions to set reminders for your personal need like you want to be reminded of a calling a customer/driver tomorrow at a specific time.
WhatIsCustomMission.ViewCustomMissions: On the mission control page, you can identify if a mission is custom created by the 'Custom' badge.

CreatingCustom.Title: Creating a custom mission
CreatingCustom.Description: You can create a custom mission by clicking on the 'Add Custom Mission' button at the top of the mission control page.
CreatingCustom.Fields: You must select the entity with its ID (leave blank if not sure or if it is a generic reminder), message for the alert, whether it is critical and a due date-time.

ModifyingCustom.Title: Editing a custom mission
ModifyingCustom.Description: You can modify a custom mission by clicking on the 'Edit' button in a mission card.
ModifyingCustom.Fields: You can change all the details of the customer mission.

WhatIsFeed.Title: Understanding feed
WhatIsFeed.Description: Feed notifications tells you about all the activities happening across the agency, like a new vehicle getting added, a booking being completed, etc. It is a central hub for all the agency-wide notifications.
WhatIsFeed.ViewFeed: You can view the feed by clicking on the 'Notification Feed' option in the sidebar.
WhatIsFeed.FilterFeed: You may also filter the feed by entity type. For example, you only want to see vehicle related notifications.
WhatIsFeed.Link: You may also click a feed notificationto view the details of that activity.

FAQs.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQs.Description: Get answers to common questions related to getting started

WhatMission.Question: What are mission?
WhatMission.Answer: Missions are basically what we call actionable alerts for you. For example, if a booking assigned to you is completed, you will receive an alert for this booking.

Custom.Question: Can I set my own alert reminder?
Custom.Answer: Yes, you can create custom mission to set reminders for your personal need. This feature is only available for premium plan.

WhatFeed.Question: What is the notification feed?
WhatFeed.Answer: The notification feed tells you about all the activities happening across the agency, like a new vehicle getting added, a booking being completed, etc. It is a central hub for all the agency-wide notifications.

RelatedArticles.Account: Learn how to manage your account

SupportStartedHelp.Title: Getting Started
SupportStartedHelp.Description: New to the platform and feeling stuck? Find all the help you need here.

WhatIsRyogo.Title: What is RyoGo?
WhatIsRyogo.Description: RyoGo is a travel agency management platform.
WhatIsRyogo.ValueProp: It is a simple and easy-to-use app that helps you manage your agency from one place and helps your agency staff to perform their tasks online.
WhatIsRyogo.Headline: Basically, RyoGo is a one-stop solution for managing daily operations without the hassle of tedious paperwork.

WhyNeedRyogo.Title: Why do I need RyoGo?
WhyNeedRyogo.Description: If you are running a tour and travel agency where you need to keep track of your drivers, vehicles, and bookings, Ryogo is the perfect solution.
WhyNeedRyogo.Solution: RyoGo removes all the complexity of going through various documents and manually tracking your drivers, vehicles, and bookings. You can run your entire agency from a single place.

WhenUseRyogo.Title: When should I start using RyoGo?
WhenUseRyogo.Description: If your agency has multiple vehicles and drivers and you want to delegate most of the daily workflow to your agents, RyoGo is the perfect solution.
WhenUseRyogo.Growing: If your business is starting to get hectic due to demand and you want to focus more on growing your business and providing excellent service to your customers, RyoGo provides a great scalable platform for you.

Features.Title: Features of RyoGo
Features.Description: RyoGo has various features to help you manage your travel agency operations.
Features.Caption: A list of RyoGo features
Features.Feature1Desc: Easily add and manage your fleet of vehicles and drivers. Get timely alerts for any expiration and keep track of any leaves/repairs easily.
Features.Feature2Desc: From quick creation to trip completion, manage all your bookings and leads with ease... in one place.
Features.Feature3Desc: Stay connected with customers, drivers and agents from a single communication hub so that every one is on the same page. Integrated with Whatsapp.
Features.Feature4Desc: Get real-time analytics and reports to keep track of your business performance and growth.
Features.Feature5Desc: Receive alerts, notifications and plan with the help of analytics and predictions to grow your business smoothly.
Features.Feature6Desc: All your data is kept safe and secure. No need to worry about data loss, privacy or security breaches, ever.
Features.Feature7Desc: Manage all your customers and their trips in one place. No need to maintain separate diaries.

Benefits.Title: Key benefits of RyoGo
Benefits.Description: When you start using RyoGo, you get the following benefits:
Benefits.Benefit1: 1. Consolidation of all the agency-related information in a single place
Benefits.Benefit2: 2. Saving of countless hours of manual work with automated workflows
Benefits.Benefit3: 3. Delegation of tasks to the specific user with total visibility
Benefits.Benefit4: 4. Keeping documentation up to date with timely reminders
Benefits.Benefit5: 5. Real-time collaboration with all agency members, drivers and customers
Benefits.Benefit6: 6. Snapshot view of your business performance and tips for growth

Owner.Title: Getting started as Owner
Owner.Step1: 1. As an owner, the first step is to create a new agency account and verify it with an OTP received on your email.
Owner.Step2: 2. Next, you must add a vehicle and a driver to your agency account. This is mandatory before you can start using the platform. (Optionally, you can also add an agent to delegate your daily operations.)
Owner.Step3: 3. This will complete the onboarding process and take you to your dashboard. Now, you can start creating bookings or adding more entities like agents, vehicles and drivers.

Agent.Title: Getting started as Agent
Agent.Step1: 1. An agent will receive an email when they are added to the agency by the owner.
Agent.Step2: 2. This email will have a system-generated password which must be used by the agent for logging in for the first time.
Agent.Step3: 3. After logging in, the agent must change the password immediately. This will complete the onboarding process for the agent and take you to the dashboard.

Driver.Title: Onboarding Driver
Driver.Step1: 1. A driver will receive an email when they are added to the agency.
Driver.Step2: 2. This email will have a system-generated password which must be used by the driver for logging in for the first time.
Driver.Step3: 3. After logging in, the driver must change the password immediately. This will complete the onboarding process for the driver and take you to the driver app dashboard.

Dashboard.Title: Dashboard
Dashboard.Description: Dashboard is the main hub for all your agency operations. You can do everything related to your daily workflows from here.
Dashboard.Components: Let's go through the various components of the dashboard.

Sidebar.Title: Sidebar
Sidebar.Description: Sidebar is the main menu of the app. You can view it on the left side of the dashboard. You can quicly navigate to all the main pages of the app from the sidebar menu. It is a toggleable menu.

Header.Title: Header
Header.Description: Header is the top bar of the app which contains the name of the current page. Also, it contains the 2 most critical actions of the app, that is, creating a new booking and mission control.

Home.Title: Home page
Home.Description: Home page is the default/main page of the app. You will see this main you log in. It shows you a snapshot of key metrics and business performance of the agency.
Home.Actions: You can also view your main actionable items (like your assigned bookings, etc.) on the home page for quick navigation.

Bookings.Title: Bookings page
Bookings.Description: Bookings page contains the list of all bookings in the app.
Bookings.Ongoing: This shows the list of all the bookings which are in progress, on the road.
Bookings.Upcoming: This shows the list of all the confirmed upcoming bookings.
Bookings.Completed: This shows the list of all the recently completed bookings
Bookings.Lead: This shows the list of all the  bookings which have been created but not yet confirmed. Interact with the potential leads/customers to confirm them.
Bookings.Schedule: The schedule shows a calendar view of all the ongoing and upcoming bookings for quick reference. Watch out for the bookings (in red) which need immediate attention.
Bookings.History: History shows a view of all the recently completed or started bookings.
Bookings.Details: You can click on any booking to view its details.

Vehicles.Title: Vehicles page
Vehicles.Description: Vehicles page contains the list of all vehicles added to your agency.
Vehicles.Ongoing: This shows the list of all the vehicles which are currently in use in a trip.
Vehicles.Schedule: The schedule shows a calendar view of all the vehicles along with their assigned trips or scheduled repairs.
Vehicles.Details: You can click on any vehicle to view its details.

Drivers.Title: Drivers page
Drivers.Description: Drivers page contains the list of all drivers added to your agency.

WhatIsEntity.Title: Understanding Entities
WhatIsEntity.Description: Entities are what we call our digital mapping of your physical business. RyoGo tracks various entities but these are the 5 main ones: Users, Vehicles, Drivers, Bookings and Customers.

Drivers.Title: Drivers
Drivers.Description: Driver is simply the entity under which a driver is managed and tracked in the app for trip execution. When a driver is added to the agency, a driver entity is created in the system with a driver ID. (A user entity is also created for the driver.)

Vehicles.Title: Vehicles
Vehicles.Description: Similarly, Vehicle is the entity under which a vehicle is tracked in the app. When a vehicle is added to the agency, a vehicle entity is created in the system with a vehicle ID.

Customers.Title: Customers
Customers.Description: A customer entity (with a customer ID) is created when a new customer is added to the agency.

Bookings.Title: Bookings
Bookings.Description: Booking is the entity under which an entire booking trip is managed. When a booking is created (with a booking ID), a customer is mapped to this booking. And then, the assigned driver and vehicle are also mapped to this booking.

Users.Title: Users
Users.Description: User is the entity we refer to anyone who can login and use the app on behalf of the agency. When a new user is added, an entity is created in the system with a user ID.
Users.Types: There are 3 types of users: Owner, Agent and Driver.
Users.Owner: Owner is the user entity which is created along with the agency at the start of the onboarding process.
Users.Agent: Agent is the user entity which is added by the owner. An agent can then start creating other entities like vehicles, drivers and bookings.
Users.Driver: Driver is the user entity which is created when a driver is added to the agency. So, for a driver there are 2 entities in the system: a driver ID and a user ID. Driver ID is used for booking related activities and user ID is used for app login related activities.

Others.Title: Other entities
Others.Description: Apart from these main entities, there are also a few other entities created during regular workflows in the app.
Others.Caption: A list of other entities
Others.AgencyDesc: An agency entity is created when your agency was first onboarded to the app. It has a unique ID for your agency in the system. All other entities are sub-entities of this agency entity.
Others.ExpenseDesc: An expense entity is created when an expense is added to a booking. An expense entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.TransactionDesc: An transaction entity is created when a transaction is added to a booking. A transaction entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.TripLogDesc: A trip log entity is created when a driver updates the trip status in a booking on the road. A trip log entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.OrderDesc: An order entity is created when a subscription plan is purchased by the owner.
Others.VehicleRepairDesc: A vehicle repair entity is created when a repair is scheduled for a vehicle. A vehicle repair entity is a sub-entity of a vehicle entity.
Others.DriverLeaveDesc: A driver leave entity is created when a leave is added for a driver. A driver leave entity is a sub-entity of a driver entity.

GetHelp.Question: How do I get help in RyoGo?
GetHelp.Answer: The fastest way to get answers is to browse through our detailed support documentation pages. If you still need help, you may contact our support team. If you want fast-tracked resolution, you may raise support tickets. This feature is only available in Premium plan.

MySupportBookingsHelp.Title: Bookings
MySupportBookingsHelp.Description: Get help related to bookings like trip assignments, transactions, expenses and more.

WhatIsBooking.Title: What is a booking?
WhatIsBooking.Description: A booking is a trip booked by a customer at your agency from one location to another with a driver and a vehicle to fulfill it.

Elements.Title: Booking elements
Elements.Description: A booking consists of the various elements.
Elements.Caption: A list of booking elements
Elements.BasicInfoDesc: Basic details about the booking like booking ID, status, assigned agent, etc.
Elements.CustomerDesc: Details about customer like name, phone number, address, etc.
Elements.TripDetailsDesc: Details about trip like source, destination, type (one-way, round-trip, multi-day), number of passengers, wants AC, pickup date, time, etc.
Elements.AssignmentDesc: Vehicle and Driver assigned for the booking.
Elements.VariablesDesc: Factors which will decide the price of the booking, such as distance, vehicle rate per km, driver allowance per day, commission rate, etc.
Elements.PriceDesc: Final price calculated based on all the above factors. Once booking is created, this cannot be changed.
Elements.ExpensesDesc: All the extra cost incurred after the trip starts, like fuel, toll, etc.
Elements.TransactionsDesc: All the money transactions related to the booking, like payment from customer, cash given to/from driver, etc.
Elements.TripLogsDesc: Location and timestamp log of each activity in the booking from trip start to end.
Elements.RatingDesc: Average rating given by customer and driver for a completed booking.

StatusList.Title: Booking status
StatusList.Description: A booking will have the different status based on the progress of the trip.
StatusList.Caption: A list of booking status
StatusList.Lead: A booking that is created but not yet confirmed by the assigned agent.
StatusList.Confirmed: A booking that has been confirmed by the assigned agent with pickup time and address. It can now be shared with the customer and the driver.
StatusList.InProgress: A booking that is currently being executed by the driver on the road.
StatusList.Completed: A booking that has been completed by the driver.
StatusList.Cancelled: A booking that has been cancelled by the assigned agent. A booking which once started by the driver cannot be cancelled. (An old lead booking is automatically cancelled by the system if the trip date has passed.)

BookingAssignment.Title: Booking assignment
BookingAssignment.Description: Every new booking created by the agency will be assigned a driver. All such assigned bookings are listed in order of execution on My Bookings page.

CurrentBooking.Title: Current booking
CurrentBooking.Description: The booking currently being executed by the driver will be displayed at the top of My Bookings page. Also, it will be clearly accessible on the home page.

UpcomingBookings.Title: Upcoming bookings
UpcomingBookings.Description: The next 3 upcoming bookings will be accessible on the home page. Upcoming booking can only be started after the current booking (if any) is completed.

AccessingCurrent.Title: Accessing current booking
AccessingCurrent.Description: The currently assigned booking can be accessed by the driver by going on the booking details page by clicking on the booking on home page or My Bookings page.

Steps.Title: Steps in execution
Steps.Description: A booking when executed will go through multiple steps.
Steps.Caption: A list of steps in booking execution
Steps.Started: The trip has been started by the driver.
Steps.Arrived: The driver has arrived at the pickup location of the customer.
Steps.PickedUp: The customer has been picked up by the driver.
Steps.Dropped: The customer has been dropped by the driver at the destination location.
Steps.Ended: The trip has been ended by the driver. The booking is now considered as completed.

StartTrip.Title: Start trip
StartTrip.Description: The driver can start the trip by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Start Trip'.
StartTrip.Input: When starting a trip, driver must enter the current odometer reading and take a screenshot of the odometer. You can also add any remarks optionally.
StartTrip.Warning: A trip can only be started once and cannot be undone.

Arrived.Title: Arrived at customer location
Arrived.Description: After the trip has started, the driver can mark that he has arrived at the customer's pickup location by clicking on 'Arrived'.
Arrived.Input: When marking that he has arrived, driver must enter the current odometer reading while take a screenshot of the odometer is optional.
Arrived.Warning: A multi day trip will have 'Arrived' status for every new day/trip when customer is picked up again.

PickedUp.Title: Picked up customer
PickedUp.Description: After the driver has arrived at the customer's pickup location, the driver can mark that he has picked up the customer by clicking on 'Picked Up'.
PickedUp.Input: When marking that he has picked up the customer, driver must enter the current odometer reading while take a screenshot of the odometer is optional.
PickedUp.Warning: A multi day trip will have 'Picked Up' status for every new day/trip when customer is picked up again.

Dropped.Title: Dropped customer
Dropped.Description: After reaching the destination, the driver can mark that he has dropped the customer by clicking on 'Dropped'.
Dropped.Input: When marking dropped, driver must enter the current odometer reading (taking a screenshot of the odometer is optional).
Dropped.Warning: A multi day trip will have 'Dropped' status for every new day/trip when customer is dropped again.

Ended.Title: End Trip
Ended.Description: After dropping the customer for the last time, the driver must complete the booking by clicking on 'Ended'.
Ended.Input: When marking that the trip has ended, driver must enter the current odometer reading and its screenshot. Remarks are optional
Ended.Rating: When ending a trip, the driver can provide booking and customer rating for the trip
Ended.Warning: A trip can only be 'Ended' once and cannot be undone. Moreover, ensure all the expenses are added before you end the trip.

CompletedBookings.Title: Completed Bookings
CompletedBookings.Description: All the previously completed bookings can be accessed by the driver on My Bookings page.

WhatIsExpense.Title: What is an expense?
WhatIsExpense.Definition: An expense is any additional cost incurred during the trip which was paid by the agency/driver but which shall be borne by the customer in final invoice. Such as, fuel, toll, parking, etc.
WhatIsExpense.Description: You can view all expenses related details like amount, type, and more by going to booking details page.

AddingExpense.Title: Adding an expense
AddingExpense.Description: The assigned agent, driver, or owner can add an expense by going to the booking expenses page and clicking on 'Add Expense'.
AddingExpense.Process: To add an expense, you must provide the following details: type (fuel, toll, etc.), amount, photo proof (optional), and remarks (optional)
AddingExpense.Warning: Always remember to add your expenses before ending the trip. Once you have marked a trip as Ended, expenses cannot be added/modified by you. In such cases, you must inform agent or owner to add/modify the expenses.

ModifyingExpense.Title: Modifying an expense
ModifyingExpense.Description: The assigned agent, driver, or owner can modify an expense by going to the booking expenses page and clicking on 'Edit' against an expense'. All the details can be edited.

ExpenseTypes.Title: Expense types
ExpenseTypes.Description: This is the list of expense types that are allowed for a booking.

Integration.Title: Communication integration
Integration.Description: The platform makes sure that you are always connected with your customers and agency.
Integration.Whatsapp: Because of deep integration with Whatsapp, you can always send messages to your customers or assigned agent for a booking.

Customer.Title: Interacting with customer
Customer.Description: You can send messages to the customer by going to the booking details page and clicking on 'Chat with Customer'.

Agency.Title: Interacting with agency

FAQs.Description: Get answers to common questions related to bookings

Reassign.Question: Can bookings be reassigned?
Reassign.Answer: Yes, the agency may choose to reassign driver or vehicle for a booking. This can be done only before the start of a trip.

Expenses.Question: Do expenses get added to the invoice at the completion of the booking?
Expenses.Answer: Yes, expenses (approved by agency) are used in final price adjusment when an invoice is being generated for a completed trip. Therefore, make sure to add all expenses before ending the trip.

Odometer.Question: Do I need to provide odometer reading photo proof for every step in the trip?
Odometer.Answer: The odometer reading photo proof is required at the start and end of the trip. The other steps are optional but it helps the agency keep accuracy of the trip.

WhatAreMissions.Title: Understanding missions
WhatAreMissions.Description: Missions are basically alerts generated by the system for a user to act upon. These can be critical or non-critical missions.
WhatAreMissions.AllMissions: You can view all your missions on Mission Control page (Target button in the header).

Elements.Title: Elements of a mission
Elements.Description: A mission informs about an event which has happened or about to happen and requires user's attention. The following elements in a mission helps you understand the message:
Elements.Caption: A list of mission elements
Elements.EntityDesc: The entity for which this alert is generated. The entity can be a booking, customer, driver, agency, etc. For example, when a booking is assigned, you will receive an alert for this booking.
Elements.MessageDesc: The message is a summary of the alert.

WhatIsEntity.Title: Understanding Entities
WhatIsEntity.Description: Entities are what we call our digital mapping of your physical business. RyoGo tracks various entities but these are the 5 main ones: Users, Vehicles, Drivers, Bookings and Customers.

Drivers.Title: Drivers
Drivers.Description: Driver is simply the entity under which a driver is managed and tracked in the app for trip execution. When a driver is added to the agency, a driver entity is created in the system with a driver ID. (A user entity is also created for the driver.)

Vehicles.Title: Vehicles
Vehicles.Description: Similarly, Vehicle is the entity under which a vehicle is tracked in the app. When a vehicle is added to the agency, a vehicle entity is created in the system with a vehicle ID.

Customers.Title: Customers
Customers.Description: A customer entity (with a customer ID) is created when a new customer is added to the agency.

Bookings.Title: Bookings
Bookings.Description: Booking is the entity under which an entire booking trip is managed. When a booking is created (with a booking ID), a customer is mapped to this booking. And then, the assigned driver and vehicle are also mapped to this booking.

Users.Title: Users
Users.Description: User is the entity we refer to anyone who can login and use the app on behalf of the agency. When a new user is added, an entity is created in the system with a user ID.
Users.Types: There are 3 types of users: Owner, Agent and Driver.
Users.Owner: Owner is the user entity which is created along with the agency at the start of the onboarding process.
Users.Agent: Agent is the user entity which is added by the owner. An agent can then start creating other entities like vehicles, drivers and bookings.
Users.Driver: Driver is the user entity which is created when a driver is added to the agency. So, for a driver there are 2 entities in the system: a driver ID and a user ID. Driver ID is used for booking related activities and user ID is used for app login related activities.

Others.Title: Other entities
Others.Description: Apart from these main entities, there are also a few other entities created during regular workflows in the app.
Others.Caption: A list of other entities
Others.AgencyDesc: An agency entity is created when your agency was first onboarded to the app. It has a unique ID for your agency in the system. All other entities are sub-entities of this agency entity.
Others.ExpenseDesc: An expense entity is created when an expense is added to a booking. An expense entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.TransactionDesc: An transaction entity is created when a transaction is added to a booking. A transaction entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.TripLogDesc: A trip log entity is created when a driver updates the trip status in a booking on the road. A trip log entity is a sub-entity of a booking entity.
Others.OrderDesc: An order entity is created when a subscription plan is purchased by the owner.
Others.VehicleRepairDesc: A vehicle repair entity is created when a repair is scheduled for a vehicle. A vehicle repair entity is a sub-entity of a vehicle entity.
Others.DriverLeaveDesc: A driver leave entity is created when a leave is added for a driver. A driver leave entity is a sub-entity of a driver entity.

FAQ.Subtitle: Still got any queries related to RyoGo features? Don't worry.. We will help you out.

Reassign.Question: Can owner re-assign bookings?
Reassign.Answer: Yes, owner can re-assign a booking to any other agent or himself. A new booking is assigned to the user who created it by default but can be reassigned to someone else by the owner if needed. Similarly, a vehicle or driver assigned to a booking can also be changed untill the trip starts.

PWA.Question: Do drivers need to download a heavy mobile app from the Play Store or App Store?
PWA.Answer: No. Drivers can use RyoGo with a lightweight Progressive Web App (PWA) that runs directly inside a smartphone browser. It works beautifully even on low-end devices and uses minimal mobile data. Infact, the agents and owner can also download this web app and login to their accounts from their smartphones.

AccessAnalytics.Question: Can drivers or agents see the revenue metrics or analytics?
AccessAnalytics.Answer: No. Only the owner has access revenue and advanced analytics pages. Agents can see basic charts and insights required for everyday operations and booking management. Drivers have no access to the dashboard.

Alerts.Question: How do we get alerted about vehicle document, driver license expirations or insurance renewals, etc. without manually checking every day?
Alerts.Answer: RyoGo dynamically checks for such expiration alerts in real-time and adds them to Mission Control. Critical alerts will also be highlighted on your dashboard.

Conflict.Question: When creating a new booking, do we get to know if a vehicle or driver is available or already assigned to another booking?
Conflict.Answer: Yes, the system clearly flags that a driver or vehicle has a conflicting schedule for the days selected in a new booking. This is one of the biggest advantages of using RyoGo.

Status.Question: How will I know which all trips will start or complete soon?
Status.Answer: All ongoing trips are displayed in the dashboard. Any upcoming, completed trips and even open leads are also listed on the bookings page. You can also view all the trips in a calendar view.

Payment.Question: Is customer booking payment also handled by RyoGo?
Payment.Answer: No, RyoGo is not a booking platform or a middleman between customers and travel agencies. We are here to help travel agencies and fleet operators run their operations more efficiently by centralizing all information and provide insights. However, we do help you in sharing documents, invoices and updates with customers online.

TripSheet.Question: Do I need to send trip sheet or any other information to driver on WhatsApp?
TripSheet.Answer: No, driver can just login from his account and view all the assigned trips along with their details.

BookingConfirmation.Question: How do customers receive booking confirmation or invoices for their trips?
BookingConfirmation.Answer: On the booking details page, you can click 'Send Confirmation'. This will open WhatsApp chat with the customer directly with the document attached. You just need to press send in WhatsApp.

TrackingLink.Question: Customers keep asking where is the vehicle? How does RyoGo help?
TrackingLink.Answer: Although there is no login for customers in RyoGo, you can send a tracking link to the customer on WhatsApp. Customers can then view live trip status on their phones.

Languages.Question: What languages are supported?
Languages.Answer: RyoGo is available in English and Hindi. We will be adding more languages soon.

LeaveRepair.Question: A driver has to go on leave or a vehicle will be in repair. How can I make sure they are not assigned during those dates?
LeaveRepair.Answer: RyoGo provides an option to add driver leave or vehicle repair dates. The system will flag them during booking assignment.

Transactions.Question: Customer made advance payment or paid some amount to the driver during the trip. Or the agency gave some cash to the driver before the trip started. How do I keep track of all these transactions?
Transactions.Answer: In RyoGo, you can easily add all these money 'Transactions' for a booking and review them at the end of the trip. Final invoice will also be adjusted automatically.

Expenses.Question: Driver sometimes pay for trip out of their pocket like fuel, parking, toll etc. How do I keep track of them and adjust them in invoice?
Expenses.Answer: Assigned agent or even the driver can simply add them as 'Expenses' to a booking. Final invoice will also be adjusted automatically.

DataPrivacy.Question: Will my agency or customer data be shared with other businesses?
DataPrivacy.Answer: Absolutely not. All your data is kept secured and private in RyoGo. We will not share your data with any third party or other businesses. Now or in the future.

FAQ.Title: Frequently Asked Questions
FAQ.Subtitle: Have any confusion about how RyoGo works? We've got you covered.

OnboardingTime.Question: How long does it take to get our agency up and running on the platform?
OnboardingTime.Answer: You can go live in under 10 minutes. Onboarding is a simple 5-step process: you input your basic business details, verify your account, then add a vehicle, driver, and agent. That's it! No credit card, long form or complicated formalities.

Entities.Question: What are 'Entities' in the system, and how do they relate to my physical business?
Entities.Answer: Entities are the digital mapping of your physical business. RyoGo mainly tracks 4 entities: Vehicles (Your cars/buses/vans/bikes with their registration numbers, model, documents and rates per Km), Drivers (with phone numbers, address, license details, and allowance per day), Agents (with phone number) and Bookings (with customer and trip details).

TechnicalKnowledge.Question: Do I need to know any techical knowledge to use RyoGo?
TechnicalKnowledge.Answer: Not at all. RyoGo is designed for simplicity and speed. You just need to add vehicles, drivers and start creating bookings (with our guidance). We will handle the rest.

WithoutComputer.Question: Can my agency use RyoGo without any computer?
WithoutComputer.Answer: Absolutely, you can use RyoGo on your smartphones with internet. You can either open RyoGo in your browser just like any other website or download the RyoGo web app on your phone.

NoAgent.Question: Can I use RyoGo without any agent?
NoAgent.Answer: Yes, absolutely. Adding agents is optional. Owners can themselves do everything in RyoGo. But delegating tasks to other agents is recommended if you want to grow your business.

DriverActions.Question: What all can a driver do in RyoGo?
DriverActions.Answer: Driver can view assigned bookings, call customer, update trip status in single clicks (like arrived at location, customer picked up, dropped, etc), add expenses, view past bookings, view assigned vehcile details, initiate chat with agent, etc. All actions are review by the system for fraud or malpractice.

AgentActions.Question: What all can an agent do in RyoGo?
AgentActions.Answer: Agent can add vehicles, drivers and customers, create and manage bookings, share trip details with customer, assign driver/vehicle, add transactions and expenses.

NewBooking.Question: How is a new booking created? Explain in detail.
NewBooking.Answer: New booking is created in 5 easy steps and it takes less than a minute with system guidance. First, the customer is selected or added using a phone number. Second, trip details (location, date, type, etc.) are selected. Third, driver and vehicle are assigned (optional). Fourth, trip costs (vehicle rate, driver allowance, agency commission, etc.) are input, if not already prefilled. Finally, overall trip summary can be reviewed to create the booking. Please note that, a bew booking is created as a lead and must be confirmed by the agent.
